label: oniballoon_matching_msg_01_00
text: Do you want to leave this team?

label: oniballoon_matching_msg_02_00
text: Do you want to disband the team?

label: oniballoon_matching_msg_03_00
text: One or more members of your team are not\nready yet. Please wait a bit before departing.

label: oniballoon_entrynpc_01
text: Welcome! You here for some Ogre Oustin’?

label: oniballoon_entrynpc_02
text: Let’s get you on out there so you can start oustin’\nsome ogres!

label: oniballoon_entrynpc_03
text: Come on back any time, ya hear?

label: oniballoon_entrynpc_04
text: Congrats on gettin’ through all the easy stages!\nTake these to commemorate your first time\r\nclearin’ that difficulty level!

label: oniballoon_entrynpc_05
text: You did a mighty fine job out there. I bet you’ll\nbe able to handle the normal stages now!

label: oniballoon_entrynpc_06
text: Congrats on gettin’ through all the normal stages!\nTake these to commemorate your first time\r\nclearin’ that difficulty level!

label: oniballoon_entrynpc_07
text: You did a mighty fine job out there. I bet you’ll\nbe able to handle the hard stages now!

label: oniballoon_entrynpc_08
text: Congrats on getting through all the hard stages!\nDefinitely doesn’t happen every day!

label: oniballoon_entrynpc_08_2
text: I reckon you might be the right Trainer to handle\nthat Pokémon...

label: oniballoon_entrynpc_08_3
text: Every time we started Ogre Oustin’, it’d draw\nin a Munchlax from ’round here...and boy, it\r\nhad quite an appetite!

label: oniballoon_entrynpc_08_4
text: Matter o’ fact, the game would get a whole\nlot harder while it was around...

label: oniballoon_entrynpc_08_5
text: So yeah, I was thinkin’ you should take it\nwith you!

label: oniballoon_entrynpc_08_6
text: You got a Munchlax from the lady!

label: oniballoon_entrynpc_09
text: Uh-oh! Your Boxes are full, huh? Why don’t you\ncome on back after doing a little housekeepin’?

label: oniballoon_entrynpc_12
text: Oh yeah, the Munchlax! Here ya go—for real,\nthis time!
